name: Adriana Arnett
life: “My first depot kept delivery photographs in a biscuit tin.” On Saturday, near Ferris Deli, Adriana asks for the end slice and listens to the names the counter workers use for regulars.
voice: I have the delivery photo of both dogs in the same yard. I want the courier credited for solving it.
appearance: On an ordinary day, look for a sand-colored linen shirt and a cloth patch so neatly matched it only shows in strong light. Adriana has a flat bridge to the nose and a mobile brow, with a swept fringe and a closely clipped nape. Adriana turns fully toward the person speaking during a conversation.
personality: Likes beautiful, unnecessary things and gets cross with people who mistake poverty for a lack of taste. Adriana takes longer choosing a cheap birthday card than an expensive coat.
agenda: To credit the driver who photographed both dogs.
family: Merit Shaw is Adriana’s half-sibling. Adriana chooses the music. Merit puts the kettle on. The cups come out before either brings up the reason for the visit. They trust a difficult conversation more if it has had an ordinary beginning. Asked about *A chair on the quay*, Merit says, “I offered to pay to ship it to his sister. Then I learned they haven't spoken in eleven years.”
connections: Leon Gao. The delivery picture lets the engraver finish the two distinct tags.

reactions.situation: A parent wants both dogs handed over immediately
reactions.response: Adriana waits until the dogs and the children are settled before discussing the handover.

reactions.situation: A traveler asks for the last seat at the bus stop
reactions.response: Adriana gives up their own space if possible and asks the passengers who arrived first to choose what happens next.
reactions.asWritten: A traveler asks for the last seat at the bus stop. Adriana gives up their own space if possible and asks the passengers who arrived first to choose what happens next.

reactions.situation: When a relative dismisses a little luxury
reactions.response: Adriana asks which ordinary pleasure the relative would give up first.
